name: ESPHome Dashboard
author: David Reed
description: Fleet status for your ESPHome devices in the Omarchy bar. Finds every device over mDNS (the same service Home Assistant uses) and TCP-checks each one's API port, so the pill shows how many are online at a glance and turns urgent when one drops. The popup lists each device with platform, board, firmware version, and latency, and flags any device whose API has no Noise encryption set. No configuration or credentials needed.

barWidget.description: How many of your ESPHome devices are online, right in the bar - accent/urgent when one drops. Popup lists every device with platform, board, firmware version, latency, and an unencrypted-API warning where it applies.

schema.label: How often to rescan and health-check (seconds, minimum 10)
Notify for which events (comma list): offline,online,new - or 'all'
Auto-dismiss notification after N seconds (0 = daemon default)
Comma-separated mDNS names to ignore (e.g. devices you don't want tracked)
Log raw CLI output to the shell log: on or off
